cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 shows civil servants' salaries in general, social transfers or pensions paid digitally; the November 2025 salary convention gives no go-live. No check against the ID or a social registry is held.
cells.note: In March 2024 UNHCR said 158 refugee teachers, helped by the education ministry to open bank accounts, are paid salaries by bank transfer: a government salary paid digitally in service, so stage 3. No second main stream is shown.
